AddHole.description: Cylindrical hole drilled into `face` at `position_mm` (face-local XY), along -normal.
AddHole.title: AddHole

ArcSketchSegment.description: A circular arc from point i to point i+1 around ``center_mm``.
ArcSketchSegment.title: ArcSketchSegment

Boolean.description: Combine two bodies; the result replaces `target` and `tool` is consumed.
Boolean.title: Boolean

CircularPattern.description: Repeat a body around an axis; count includes the original body.
CircularPattern.title: CircularPattern

CreateBox.description: Axis-aligned box. Its minimum corner sits at `origin_mm` unless `centered`.
CreateBox.title: CreateBox

CreateCone.description: Cone or frustum along `axis`; `origin_mm` is the bottom-face centre.
CreateCone.title: CreateCone

CreateTorus.description: Ring centred at `origin_mm`, with `axis` through its hole.
CreateTorus.title: CreateTorus

Extrude.description: Extrude a planar profile from ``origin_mm`` along the plane normal.
Extrude.title: Extrude

FaceByNormal.description: The planar face whose outward normal points along ±axis (e.g. the top face: +z).
FaceByNormal.title: FaceByNormal

FixedConstraint.description: Keep one sketch point at the coordinates supplied in ``points_mm``.
FixedConstraint.title: FixedConstraint

LineSketchSegment.description: A straight segment from point i to point i+1 (wrapping at the end).
LineSketchSegment.title: LineSketchSegment

LinearPattern.description: Repeat a body along one axis and fuse the copies into the same result body.
LinearPattern.title: LinearPattern

Loft.description: Create an exact solid through profiles on parallel, consistently oriented planes.
Loft.title: Loft

Mirror.description: Mirror a body across an axis-aligned plane, optionally keeping the original.
Mirror.title: Mirror

Revolve.description: Revolve a closed profile in the radial/axial plane around an exact axis.
Revolve.title: Revolve

SetDimensions.description: Uniformly rescale a body so its bounding box matches the given sizes (any subset).
SetDimensions.title: SetDimensions

SetParameter.description: T-038: edit one numeric parameter of an earlier operation; the plan is replayed.
SetParameter.title: SetParameter

Shell.title: Shell

SketchProfile.description:
A closed sketch solved before it becomes an exact B-Rep wire.

Point indices are stable plan data rather than kernel topology ids. The numerical solver
moves the supplied starting points only as far as needed and refuses inconsistent systems.
When ``segments`` is omitted every point is joined to the next with a line for backward
compatibility. Otherwise segment i joins point i to point i+1, wrapping at the end.
SketchProfile.title: SketchProfile

SplineSketchSegment.description: An interpolating B-spline through the endpoints and these interior points.
SplineSketchSegment.title: SplineSketchSegment

Sweep.description: Sweep a closed profile along an open 3D polyline using the corrected Frenet frame.
Sweep.title: Sweep
